title: Chinese Ginger Chicken

items: 2 chicken breasts, chopped into bite-size pieces
Dried red pepper flakes, to taste
Salt and black pepper to taste

steps: Combine the chicken pieces with ginger, garlic, olive oil, honey, corn starch, soy sauce, red pepper flakes, salt, and black pepper. Mix well and marinate for 30 minutes.
While the chicken marinates, slice the onions and bell peppers into strips.
Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a frying pan over high heat. Fry the chicken until cooked through and lightly browned, about 5-6 minutes. Remove and set aside.
Add 1 tbsp olive oil to the same pan. Add ginger and garlic, stir-fry for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the onions and fry for 1 minute.
Add the red and green bell pepper strips and fry for 2 minutes.
Mix the chicken broth, soy sauce, and corn starch in a small bowl until smooth.
Return the chicken to the pan, pour the broth mixture over everything, and cook for 5 minutes until the sauce thickens.
tips: Do not skip the marinade � 30 minutes minimum, 1 hour is even better. Corn starch in both the marinade and sauce keeps the chicken tender and the sauce glossy.
